desc:
Fight with Boxing, Sumo, Taekwondo, and Karate in Martial Arts Battlegrounds! Master your fighting style, chain powerful combos, and unleash ultimate abilities in fast-paced PvP battles.

🔥 NEW: HEAVEN PORTAL & SKILL VARIANTS
Complete the requirements to enter Heaven through the new portal and unlock new variants of your skills.

🥊 MASTER YOUR STYLE
Each martial art has its own moves, combos, and ultimate. Block, dash, throw, and outplay your opponents in the arena.

🎮 PC CONTROLS
• Left Click — Attack
• F — Block
• Q — Dash
• E — Throw
• W + Q — Dash Impact
• G — Ultimate
• R — Special Ability

📱 PC & MOBILE
Console support coming soon.

⭐ Like & Favorite to support the game and help us reach 5,000 Likes!
